name: ENHANCED VIOLENCE
text: This turning point a friendly Goremonger with a half gore tank has Balanced on its melee weapons, and one with a full tank has Relentless. The tank is read live, after any Sanguavitae lowering. Thrown weapons from Wrist Chains keep these rules.

name: AUGMENTED ENDURANCE
text: This turning point, when an operative shoots a friendly Goremonger, the defender may re-roll one defence die if its tank is half, or any of them if it is full.

name: GORY TENACITY
text: This turning point, when a friendly Goremonger fights or retaliates, the first time the opponent strikes it in that sequence the damage is halved, rounding up, but never below 2 (and never raised).

name: HUNT FOR BLOOD
text: Pick one friendly Goremonger. A Conceal order becomes Engage. It may then take a free Charge of at most 3 inches.

name: UNBRIDLED AGGRESSION
text: When a friendly Goremonger fights in an activation in which it Charged, at the end of the Roll Attack Dice step its melee weapons have Severe until the end of the sequence.

name: GORETHIRST
text: When you would counteract, you may do so with a friendly Goremonger that has a Conceal order. It changes to Engage first and may only Charge, Shoot or Fight in that counteraction.

name: DESTRUCTIVE DEMISE
text: When a friendly Goremonger is incapacitated, before it is removed, it deals damage to one enemy in its control range: D3 if its tank is empty, D3+1 if half, D3+2 if full.

name: LACERATE FLESH
text: When a friendly Goremonger with an empty tank activates or counteracts, raise its tank one level. When the activation or counteraction ends, lower it one level (not a Sanguavitae use); if it cannot be lowered, the operative takes D3 damage.
